decisions.decision: The ratings for the Town Manager evaluation will run from 0-4 (with a Not Observed option that is not counted).
decisions.quote: after some discussion the ratings will go from 0-4.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager evaluation's 'consensus' wording will be changed to 'composite'.
decisions.quote: consensus will be changed to composite.

decisions.decision: Town labor counsel will check with the Attorney General's office on the statement that individual evaluation forms are not publicly released.
decisions.quote: it was decided to have town labor counsel check with the attorney general's office on the statement.

decisions.decision: Board members will review the evaluation headings first, and bullet points will be taken up at a later meeting; members to come prepared with up to 4 bullets per category.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo suggested everyone view the headings and see if they are okay and then we can come back about the bullet points.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will send out the updated evaluation document.
decisions.quote: town manager will send out the updated document.

decisions.decision: The Chair will ask town counsel the questions raised about the evaluation process.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo will ask town counsel all the questions asked this evening about the process.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will post the Planning Board Unitil hearing meeting notice.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will post the meeting.

decisions.decision: Chair suggested contacting the Parks Commission about notifying beach staff earlier next year, as the Commission interviews and recommends hires to the Town Manager.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo suggested contacting the parks commission as they do the interviewing and recommend to hire to the town manager.
